hooks.command: if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); else cmd=$(cat); fi; case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) echo "⚠️ Reminder: update CLAUDE.md with the changes in this commit before committing. If you already did, proceed." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); else fp=$(cat); fi; case "$fp" in *frontend/app/*|*frontend/components/*|*.css) echo "⚠️ Reminder: read docs/DESIGN.md before making UI changes. It contains the canonical spec for colors, fonts, hero layout, category grid, ProducerCard, Footer, etc." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); else fp=$(cat); fi; case "$fp" in *backend/*) echo "⚠️ Reminder: read docs/DATA.md before making backend changes. It contains the DB schema and API contract." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; if [ ! -d "$root/frontend" ]; then echo "frontend/ not found at $root, skipping build"; exit 0; fi; set -o pipefail; cd "$root/frontend" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"Frontend build failed — fix errors before completing this task"}'"'"''

hooks._comment: Vitest component tests. Blocks on failure. Skips gracefully if vitest not installed or __tests__/ missing.
hooks.command: bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; if [ ! -d "$root/frontend/__tests__" ]; then echo "Warning: frontend/__tests__/ not found, skipping component tests"; exit 0; fi; cd "$root/frontend" && npx vitest run --reporter=verbose 2>&1 | tail -30; test ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 || echo '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"Vitest component tests failed — fix errors before completing this task"}'"'"''

hooks._comment: Backend pytest. Blocks on real test failures. Graceful skip if pytest not installed or test file missing. Install pytest via: pip install pytest pytest-asyncio httpx -r backend/requirements.txt --break-system-packages
hooks.command: bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; if ! python -m pytest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Warning: pytest not available — install via: pip install pytest pytest-asyncio httpx --break-system-packages"; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d "$root/backend" ]; then echo "Warning: backend/ not found, skipping"; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f "$root/backend/tests/test_api.py" ]; then echo "Warning: backend/tests/test_api.py not found, skipping backend tests"; exit 0; fi; cd "$root/backend" && python -m pytest tests/test_api.py -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -20; test ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 || echo '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"Backend tests failed — fix errors before completing this task"}'"'"''
